eval_tokens: eval the average thinking tokens in model responses using a tokenizer and model name
eval_tokens_o3_model: eval tokens for an o3 model response row that includes pre-computed token counts
eval_tokens_multi_response: eval tokens across multiple responses in a single row by averaging think token counts
review_eval_tokens: review the eval_tokens function to understand how it splits responses on the closing answer tag
refactor_eval_tokens: refactor eval_tokens to support additional model families beyond o3 with custom token extraction logic
